segments.contextAfter: `path`: The path at which to write the contents of the array. If `path` contains a tilde (~) character, you must expand it with [`expandingTildeInPath`](nsstring/expandingtildeinpath.md) before invoking this method.

segments.contextAfter: `useAuxiliaryFile`: If [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the array is written to an auxiliary file, and then the auxiliary file is renamed to `path`. If [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), the array is written directly to `path`. The [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) option guarantees that `path`, if it exists at all, won’t be corrupted even if the system should crash during writing.
